text:
## What's Changed
* Fix Tooltips crashing for extremely large byte amounts (#8991)
* Fix Spatial Anchor overlay rendering in 1.20.1 by @paperky in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8630
* Be more lenient about misplaced addon crafting storage units leading to permanent world crashes by @pedroksl in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8707
* Fix Korean translation by @Mithi83 in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8936
* Fix ingredients being moved out of the crafting grid when transferring a recipe not being used for other slots of that recipe

## New Contributors
* @paperky made their first contribution in https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/pull/8630

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AppliedEnergistics/Applied-Energistics-2/compare/forge/v15.4.10...forge/v15.4.11
